description: Quantify GR inhibition at measured PH3 HOG concentrations vs the Ki from Riedel 2012
code:
import numpy as np, matplotlib
matplotlib.use("Agg")
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- Parameters from Riedel et al. 2012 (PMID 22771891, PMC3418427) ----
Ki_HOG = 1.75      # mM, global fit (±0.85); point-estimate also quoted ~1.0 mM
Ki_lo, Ki_hi = 1.0, 1.8   # reported range across fits

# Measured HOG in PH3 patients (Table 2, Riedel 2012)
serum_HOG_uM = 0.89          # µM (range 0.5-1.43)
liver_HOG_pmol_per_mg = 34.3 # pmol/mg protein (range 27.3-38.8)

# Convert liver pmol/mg protein -> approximate intracellular concentration (µM)
# Liver protein density per unit cell water: literature ~ 0.20 g protein / g tissue,
# cell water ~0.7 mL/g  -> ~286 mg protein / mL cell water. Give a sensitivity range.
prot_mg_per_mL = {"low (150)":150, "mid (250)":250, "high (350)":350}
print("=== Liver intracellular HOG estimate (bulk, whole-cell average) ===")
liver_est = {}
for lbl,dens in prot_mg_per_mL.items():
    # pmol/mg * mg/mL = pmol/mL = nM ; /1000 -> µM... check: 34.3 pmol/mg *250 mg/mL =8575 pmol/mL=8.575 nmol/L*? 
    conc_pmol_per_mL = liver_HOG_pmol_per_mg * dens      # pmol/mL
    conc_uM = conc_pmol_per_mL / 1000.0                  # pmol/mL = nmol/L? -> 1 pmol/mL = 1 nmol/L =0.001 µM
    # careful: 1 pmol/mL = 1 pmol / 1e-3 L = 1e-9 mol/L *? 1 pmol=1e-12 mol; /1e-3 L =1e-9 mol/L =1 nM
    conc_uM = conc_pmol_per_mL * 1e-3                     # nM -> µM  (1 pmol/mL = 1 nM = 1e-3 µM)
    liver_est[lbl]=conc_uM
    print(f"  protein density {lbl} mg/mL -> {conc_pmol_per_mL:.0f} pmol/mL = {conc_pmol_per_mL:.0f} nM = {conc_uM:.2f} µM")

# Fractional inhibition of GR as function of [HOG], simple reversible inhibition f = I/(I+Ki)
def frac_inh(I_uM, Ki_mM):
    I_mM = I_uM/1000.0
    return I_mM/(I_mM+Ki_mM)

print("\n=== Fractional GR inhibition at measured PH3 HOG levels (Ki=1.75 mM) ===")
for name,conc in [("serum 0.89 µM",serum_HOG_uM)] + [(f"liver {l}={c:.1f}µM",c) for l,c in liver_est.items()]:
    print(f"  {name:28s}: {100*frac_inh(conc,Ki_HOG):.3f}% inhibition")

# How much HOG needed for 50% inhibition? = Ki
print(f"\n  [HOG] for 50% GR inhibition = Ki = {Ki_HOG*1000:.0f} µM (= {Ki_HOG} mM)")
# fold gap vs measured bulk liver mid
mid = liver_est["mid (250)"]
print(f"  Fold-gap: serum below Ki = {Ki_HOG*1000/serum_HOG_uM:.0f}x ; liver(mid) below Ki = {Ki_HOG*1000/mid:.0f}x")
# Even with mitochondrial enrichment (~5x volume concentration) and cytosolic GRHPR relevance:
print(f"  Hypothetical 5x mito enrichment of liver(mid) -> {5*mid:.1f} µM -> {100*frac_inh(5*mid,Ki_HOG):.2f}% inhibition")

# ---- Plot dose-inhibition curve with measured concentrations marked ----
I = np.logspace(0, 4.5, 500)  # µM, 1 to ~31000
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8,5))
for Ki,ls,lab in [(Ki_lo,"--","Ki=1.0 mM"),(Ki_HOG,"-","Ki=1.75 mM"),(Ki_hi,":","Ki=1.8 mM")]:
    ax.plot(I, 100*frac_inh(I,Ki), ls, color="navy", label=lab)
ax.axvline(serum_HOG_uM, color="green", lw=1.5)
ax.text(serum_HOG_uM*1.05, 60, "PH3 serum\n0.89 µM", color="green", fontsize=8)
ax.axvspan(liver_est["low (150)"], liver_est["high (350)"], color="orange", alpha=0.3)
ax.text(mid*1.1, 72, "PH3 liver\n~5-12 µM\n(bulk est.)", color="darkorange", fontsize=8)
ax.axvline(Ki_HOG*1000, color="red", lw=1, ls="-.")
ax.text(Ki_HOG*1000*1.05, 20, "Ki (50% inhib)\n1.75 mM", color="red", fontsize=8)
ax.set_xscale("log"); ax.set_xlabel("[HOG] (µM, log scale)"); ax.set_ylabel("% GR inhibition")
ax.set_title("GR inhibition by HOG: measured PH3 concentrations vs inhibitory range\n(Riedel 2012 kinetics + Table 2 concentrations)")
ax.legend(loc="center left"); ax.grid(alpha=0.3)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.savefig("gr_inhibition_vs_HOG.png", dpi=130)
print("\nSaved plot gr_inhibition_vs_HOG.png")
